comment: Maps PPC-spiral kernel IDs to the criterion bench-target / size leaves they will compare against. Pinned by jit:b2ecd2ff (session 2 of babcf05e) using `cargo bench --save-baseline ppc-v0-2026-04-27` against HEAD=52eaac8. The bench inventory under `crates/gf2-core/benches/` was swept end-to-end at pin time; pinned kernels reflect the full set of bench files extant at HEAD that map to a Tier-A/B/C/D kernel. Consumed by dev/benchmarks/ppc-compare.sh and the criterion-1.5x JIT gate via scripts/criterion-1.5x.sh; the gate is per-issue keyed by a `ppc-kernel:<id>` label (id is one of A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3, C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, D1, D2). Path resolution: `$CRITERION_DIR/$bench_target/$size/$baseline_name/estimates.json` — `bench_target` may include slashes for nested groups (e.g., `gf2m_mul_crossover/pclmulqdq_barrett`), and `size` may be `.` for leaf benches with no parameter. Entries marked TBD-* have no current bench in `crates/gf2-core/benches/`; the kernel-implementing task is expected to add a dedicated bench before its first spiral edit. B1 was pinned in jit:1c1c4242 (V0 step) against the new `crates/gf2-core/benches/matrix_transpose.rs` bench. Currently TBD: C5 (CubicExt has no SoA bench; `soa_batch.rs` covers QuadraticExt only), D2 (no Cuthill-McKee reorder bench).

A3.title: Generic Fp prime FieldVec batch dispatch (Solinas-friendly)

C1.title: GF(2^m) batch m=8/16/32 via VPCLMULQDQ
C1.amendment_note: Replaced bench_target `gf2m_mul_crossover/pclmulqdq_barrett` (single-shot per-element kernel) with the batch leaf `gf2m_mul_crossover/gf2m_batch_unroll4` and an apples-to-apples baseline leaf `gf2m_mul_crossover/pclmulqdq_barrett_loop_v0` (existing single-shot kernel called per-element in a tight loop over the same BATCH_SIZE=1024 inputs). Both leaves are produced by `bench_gf2m_batch_pclmulqdq_unroll4` in `crates/gf2-core/benches/gf2m_mul_strategies.rs`. ppc-compare.sh compares current-vs-current via `baseline_bench_target` rather than a saved-baseline lookup; pinning a saved baseline at the new leaf would not be apples-to-apples because the V0 path is also new (the old `pclmulqdq_barrett` leaf measured a different, single-multiplication workload).

C3.title: Fp prime Montgomery batch SIMD (AVX2)
C3.rationale: C3 measures a generic 64-bit Montgomery batch (P=M61_LIKE_GENERIC=2^61-45, neither Mersenne nor Proth), exercising the generic-Fp AVX2 kernel through gf2-kernels-simd::fp_generic::detect(). The previous M31 leaf measured the M31 specialised path, not the general Montgomery batch.

C5.title: CubicExt::mul Karatsuba SoA batched SIMD
C5.tbd_reason: Depends on C4 SoA scaffolding; bench piggybacks on C4's once C4 lands.

D2.title: SparseBitMatrix Cuthill-McKee row reorder
D2.tbd_reason: Cuthill-McKee one-shot reorder bench doesn't exist at HEAD. D2 task adds it (amortise-many-matvecs measurement) before its first edit.
